Nos_engagements.title: Our commitments for a positive impact
Nos_engagements.Pas_de_Pauvrete_texte: We plan to hire local labor regardless of the area of implementation, including in regions with low economic development. We invest in local businesses, support start-ups, and lay the foundation for an effective fight against poverty.
Nos_engagements.Faim_texte: We enable the development of sustainable agriculture without overexploiting the soil, allowing local farmers to use part of our resources without incurring massive transportation costs. We also provide them with additional income and digestate that meets organic farming standards to maximize their yields. This way, farmers can produce food crops locally.
Nos_engagements.BonneSante_texte: Through our activities in waste recovery and the production of therapeutic plants, we foster the development and synthesis of treatments against addictions, mortality caused by certain pathologies, and mental and psychological disorders. We also drastically reduce illnesses caused by pollutants, chemicals, and waste accumulation.
Nos_engagements.edcucation_texte: We may require a wide range of skills and will hire personnel with all types of qualifications. Our goal is to have almost the entire educational spectrum represented internally. We will also train and finance the studies of promising young individuals. Additionally, we will invest in educational campaigns for local populations (notably in waste sorting and disposal).
Nos_engagements.egalite_texte: We aim to achieve perfect gender parity. Salaries will be based on skills, performance, and work delivered. No wage discrimination will occur based on gender, and the company ensures equal career and advancement opportunities for all. We will also be vigilant in choosing our locations and partners, ensuring we do not support structures or states that go against this principle.
Nos_engagements.eauSalubre_title: Access to Clean Water and Sanitation
Nos_engagements.eauSalubre_texte: We provide solutions to purify water, making it drinkable or usable for agriculture. In doing so, we enable the re-use of this vital resource. In other words, we treat, recover, and purify wastewater and contaminated water. By preventing the release of polluted water into nature, we preserve rivers and their ecosystems. This also facilitates access to clean drinking water for all.
Nos_engagements.energieFiable_title: Affordable, Reliable, Sustainable, and Modern Energy
Nos_engagements.energieFiable_texte: Our energy is 100% renewable, and we even recover heat to generate electricity or provide heating. Through our ambition for international expansion and the features of our model, we can develop renewable energy and heat networks worldwide.
Nos_engagements.emploi_texte: Given the innovative nature of our project, its ability to rehabilitate polluted areas for tourism, and the fact that our team is mainly composed of young people, we see this as a strong additional argument for generating sustainable jobs.
Nos_engagements.industrie_texte: The circular economy and autonomy in energy and resources form the very foundation of our model. With this energy independence comes the inevitable opportunity to develop an entire economic and industrial ecosystem based on renewable energies.
Nos_engagements.reduction_texte: Our team includes as many women as men in key positions and is composed of individuals from various nationalities. As a future multinational, we are committed to recruiting talent wherever it is found. All employees will benefit from the same opportunities and access to key positions based on merit. The companyâ€™s CEO himself holds an RQTH and is officially recognized as a disabled worker.
Nos_engagements.villes_texte: A clean city powered by green electricity is a sustainable city. We are committed to ensuring the energy independence of these communities while promoting green and low-carbon mobility. By organizing renewable heat and cooling networks, we also contribute to reducing costs and lowering gas and electricity consumption.
Nos_engagements.consommation_texte: This is the core of our model: we recover almost all hard-to-reuse materials and waste and transform them into resources. We also support and assist states in transitioning toward a circular economy and in organizing responsible waste management. Companies are also offered a waste recovery service to prevent dumping into nature.
Nos_engagements.lutteChangement_texte: We reduce greenhouse gas emissions from the decomposition of certain materials, emit no GHGs ourselves, and help reduce or even eliminate the consumption of fossil energy sources such as coal, which are highly polluting. Thanks to the proximity and interconnection of our facilities with waste concentration areas, we also reduce transportation needs by recovering and producing locally.
Nos_engagements.conserver_title: Conserve and Sustainably Use the Oceans, Seas, and Marine Resources
Nos_engagements.conserver_texte: We reduce greenhouse gas emissions from the decomposition of certain materials, emit no GHGs ourselves, and help reduce or even eliminate the consumption of fossil energy sources such as coal, which are highly polluting. Thanks to the proximity and interconnection of our facilities with waste concentration areas, we also reduce transportation needs by recovering and producing locally.
Nos_engagements.vieTerrestre_texte: Our model enables the conservation and restoration of soil life. By preventing soil depletion and enriching it, we drastically reduce the need for chemical fertilizers and soil exhaustion. By promoting sustainable agriculture and renewable resource use, we also protect biodiversity and ensure the responsible exploitation of resources.
Nos_engagements.justicePaix_texte: By preventing famines, ensuring access to water for all, and reducing economic inequalities among local populations, we help limit tensions and the risk of war.
Nos_engagements.Partenariats_texte: Our approach is based on partnership and requires the joint action of several private partners and public institutions. We have communicated, informed, and described our model clearly and freely, and we have also provided free consulting services to communities. We also plan international investments, including in developing countries.

__comment_page_constat: Traductions pour la page Notre Constat (Constat.vue)

notre_constat.intro1_Le monde continue: The world continues to evolve at a rapid pace, and new opportunities arise every day. In this era of transformation, it is essential to explore the solutions that will shape our future.
notre_constat.intro2_Ces solutions sont vastes: These solutions are vast and diverse, but they all share a common goal: addressing today's challenges through innovation, creativity, and collaboration. It is exciting to imagine how these emerging solutions will shape our future and pave the way for a better world. Letâ€™s stay open to opportunities and ready to embrace change for a promising future.
notre_constat.intro3_Les avancees technologiques: Technological advances are constantly transforming the way we live, work and communicate. Areas such as artificial intelligence, the Internet of Things, virtual and augmented reality and blockchain offer fascinating opportunities for solving complex problems. Advances in these areas could not only improve our quality of life, but also revolutionise sectors such as healthcare, education, energy and many others.
notre_constat.intro4_Face aux defis: Faced with the climate challenges facing our planet, tomorrow's solutions must focus on environmental sustainability. Renewable energies, energy efficiency, waste management and the preservation of natural resources are all areas where innovative measures can be taken to reduce our ecological footprint. A sustainable future depends on our ability to rethink the way we consume and produce.
notre_constat.intro5_Nous nous sommes: We are committed to acting more responsibly in our business practices. This means reducing our carbon footprint, preserving natural resources and protecting biodiversity. We are putting our skills at the service of a more virtuous tomorrow.
notre_constat.intro6_Nous croyons en la: We believe in the transition to a circular economy, which aims to recycle, reuse and add value to products and materials rather than throwing them away. We encourage responsible consumption, sharing, repair and recycling to reduce waste and contribute to an industry with no ultimate waste.
notre_constat.intro7_Nous soutenons: We support and encourage innovation in renewable energy, waste management, sustainable transport and many other green initiatives. By investing in more sustainable solutions, we want to help create a better future.
notre_constat.intro8_En tant qu entreprise: As a company driven by these values, we strive to make a positive difference, both in our internal operations and in our impact on society. By adopting more sustainable practices and supporting environmentally-friendly initiatives, we are helping to build a greener, fairer future for everyone.
notre_constat.intro9_Notre industrie: Our Industry 5.0 is one of depollution, decarbonisation and multi-sectoriality.

projets.promethee_fin2024_texte_html: Prometheus â€” End of 2024: NaTran officially launched its Call for Expressions of Interest (AMI) for the implementation of innovative solutions in the field of renewable and low-carbon gases. In a demanding context and under strong time pressure, BTC Energies positioned itself from the very beginning, volunteering to respond to this ambitious call.
projets.promethee_fin2024_texte2_html: From the very start of operations, a small but determined team was mobilized. On the ground, our teams carried out prospecting phases, territorial analyses, and strategic drafting, despite a complex local environment marked by tensions and well-established resistance. The area targeted for the project had indeed been the subject of historical opposition for more than 20 years, both from local environmental associations and from a landowner firmly opposed to any form of industrial development.
projets.promethee_fin2024_texte3_html:
Faced with these obstacles, we chose not to rely solely on administrative procedures: BTC Energies was the only industrial player to meet directly with the landowner, adopting an approach of open and active dialogue. We presented our vision, our environmental ambition, and proposed genuine collaboration around the project.

This human and committed approach bore fruit: the landowner agreed to support the project, thus putting an end to two decades of opposition. This agreement paved the way for the project submission in a calm and transparent context. Thanks to the dedication of our employees and the decisive support of our industrial and institutional partners, we successfully overcame every step with rigor and determination.
projets.promethee_fin2024_texte4_html:
The result is clear: the project led by BTC Energies was selected. It now stands as the second largest officially approved project in France in its category, with:

  • an annual production of 202 GWh of low-carbon methane;
  • the recovery of 30,000 tons of Solid Recovered Fuels (SRF) through hydrothermal gasification.

Through this success, BTC Energies establishes itself as a national pioneer in two strategic fields:

  • industrial-scale hydrothermal gasification;
  • the recovery of SRF through wet processing, a still underexploited sector with major potential.

This project marks a major operational breakthrough in Franceâ€™s energy transition and positions BTC Energies at the intersection of climate, technological, and industrial challenges.
projets.mi2025_texte1_html:
By mid-2025, the verdict was clear: the companies claiming to offer technologies capable of meeting our needs â€” as well as those of several partner communities â€” proved unable to deliver suitable solutions. Worse still, large corporations, entrenched in their dominant positions, systematically buried emerging innovations and actively sought to slow our progress. Their strategy was clear: neutralize any initiative capable of challenging their hegemony.

Faced with this critical situation, we decided to take the initiative and launch a strategic operation around an R&D consortium. Objective: to develop a sovereign technology, free from the constraints imposed by traditional players, and able to meet real operational needs without compromise.
projets.mi2025_texte2_html:
Very quickly, major partners joined the effort. A leading research institute, two engineering consulting firms experienced in complex projects, and a company specialized in the Internet of Things committed to working alongside us. Their involvement immediately strengthened our capacity to design, test, and deploy breakthrough technology.

At the same time, investors were approached and showed strong interest. Some see this initiative as a strategic driver for dual-use technologies, both terrestrial and spatial. Others consider it a key lever for developing smart cities, where connectivity, resilience, and autonomy have become vital challenges.
projets.mi2025_texte3_html: The course is set: we will no longer endure. The consortium is taking shape, skills are coming together, and capital is aligning. This project is not just about compensating for the failures of existing solutions â€” it aims to break the lock imposed by major corporations, regain technological advantage, and ensure our independence. The maneuver is underway, and this time, we are determined to chart our own path.
projets.Septembre2025_texte1_html:
September 2025 marks a decisive step forward in our trajectory. Our president, Thibault BÃ©thencourt, was elected as Franceâ€™s representative within the H2Med Alliance.

The H2Med Alliance is the international cooperation framework built around the H2Med project, the first major European green hydrogen corridor. This project connects the Iberian Peninsula to Central Europe through France, with the mission of securing energy supply, accelerating industrial decarbonization, and positioning Europe as a global leader in hydrogen. It brings together leading industrial and institutional players involved in the energy transition.
projets.Septembre2025_texte2_html: In this context, our success takes on a historic dimension. We, a start-up without significant resources, are now sitting at the same table as global giants such as Thyssenkrupp â€” an industrial benchmark worldwide. This presence proves that the relevance of our vision and the credibility of our technology now outweigh pure financial power.
projets.Septembre2025_texte3_html: This turning point confirms our ability to influence strategic decisions, defend Franceâ€™s interests, and project our know-how on the European and international stage. Where many once saw us as a peripheral actor, we now stand as an essential force for innovation and collaboration.
